scope.summary: The new dictionary-size reset is reachable through the alone decoder's header and filter initialization path. The target's build rules remain unavailable, so coverage under the supplied recipe is unresolved.

assessments.reason: A .lzma header within the target's first input chunk can reach the changed allocation branch on a fresh decoder. Whether the target builds under the supplied recipe remains unverified because its Makefile is missing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The alone decoder parses the header and initializes the LZMA filter.
The selected filter initializer calls the changed LZ decoder initializer.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The helper supplies input to lzma_code.
The recipe delegates target compilation to an unsupplied Makefile.

build.reason: The recipe invokes make in tests/ossfuzz, but the Makefile containing the target's compile and link rules was not supplied.

evidence.dependency_reason: CMake includes the relevant decoder sources in liblzma under its decoder configuration.

input.reason: The helper presents generated bytes to the initialized decoder; its first chunk can contain a complete .lzma header, and subsequent calls provide more input.

evidence.dependency_reason: The decoder consumes the header and initializes its filter when the memory limit permits.
The entry passes the generated buffer to the helper.

lifecycle.reason: Each entry invocation starts with a fresh stream, initializes its decoder, and ends the stream after coding. The cleanup chain releases the nested decoder and dictionary.

evidence.dependency_reason: Stream initialization prepares the internal coder and supported-action state.
The alone decoder ends its nested filter.
The LZ decoder releases its dictionary and coder.

control_flow.reason: The entry initializes an alone decoder and calls lzma_code. Header parsing selects the LZMA1EXT filter; its initializer calls lzma_lz_decoder_init, where a fresh coder enters the changed allocation branch.

evidence.dependency_reason: The public initializer installs the alone decoder.
Header parsing selects and initializes the LZMA filter.
Filter initialization invokes the selected initializer.
The selected LZMA initializer calls the changed LZ decoder initializer.
A fresh coder has dictionary size zero and enters the branch containing the reset.
